Name: Bladed Halo
Description: You throw a bouncing blade of solid light. Make a single ranged spell attack against up to 3 different creatures within range that are within 10ft of each other. A target hit takes 1d4 radiant damage.
At Higher Levels: At Higher Levels. The halo can bounce more times at higher levels: 4 bounces at 5th level, 5 bounces at 11th level, and 6 bounces at 17th level. Use the same attack roll against each creature.
